subject: short-antlered deer
art_direction: 短枝角鹿头与肩颈形成纵向墨形，灰绿底和浅纸留白沉静。

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Make a deer head-and-shoulders woodcut with two short branching antlers and a broad gentle muzzle. The neck forms a single dark vertical shape, broken by cream paper lines at the cheek and chest. Use muted gray-green surroundings and a small ochre inner-ear accent. Keep the antlers modest and the expression approachable, with no trophy framing, forest landscape, elaborate texture, or text. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
